about_the_game:
Stand your ground. Defy the undead. Endure the curse.

🧟‍♂️ The undead are coming—and they won’t stop.
Your shelter is under siege. There’s no escape. No reinforcements in sight.
All you can do is build, fight, and survive.
Welcome to ZCurse, the ultimate survival experience where action, strategy, and roguelite progression collide.

🛑 This is your last stand. Will you survive it?

🛡️ Survive and Build Your Final Defense

  • Every second matters. Construct walls, lay traps, and create chokepoints to control the battlefield. Your firepower alone won’t be enough—only those who build smart will endure the endless horde.

  • 🔁 Roguelite Progression – Get Stronger Every Run

    In ZCurse, failure is part of the plan. Each attempt lets you collect resources, unlock permanent upgrades, and enhance your shelter’s defenses. The next survivor will be stronger—thanks to you.

  • ⚔️ Fast-Paced Combat Meets Tactical Decision-Making

    Think fast. Act faster. Reinforce weak points, reposition on the fly, and make critical calls as waves of zombies swarm your defenses. One wrong move can cost everything.

  • 🚁 Hold Out Until Rescue—If It Ever Comes

    You're not just fighting to kill—you’re fighting to last. Every moment you survive brings a glimmer of hope. But hope fades quickly when the dead never stop coming. Will your walls hold? Or will the curse consume you?

💥 Can You Outlast the Curse?

The nightmare doesn’t end… but you just might outlive it.

Add ZCurse to your wishlist now and prepare for a relentless battle where only the smartest—and toughest—survive

name: ZCurse

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 8 GB VRAM or higher, DirectX 11 or 12 compatible
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: ZCurse is a roguelite survival game where endless undead waves besiege your last shelter. Build defenses, fight tactically, and collect resources to grow stronger with every run. Stand your ground—or fall to the curse.
